title: Constraint
description: A generic, extensible constraint. This schema describes constraints; it does not evaluate them mathematically.

type.description: Recommended values: loop_closure, coincident, fixed_distance, fixed_orientation. Additional application-defined constraint types are permitted.

references.description: Ids of the bodies, frames, or other entities this constraint relates.

parameters.description: Constraint-specific numeric or configuration data (e.g. a fixed_distance value).

metadata.description: Opaque, application-defined data carried alongside this constraint.
